create_odds_first_task: create an OddsFirst task instance with a specified vocab_size for generating odd-index-first string generalization data
sample_batch_strings: sample a batch of random one-hot encoded strings and their odd-index-first rearranged outputs using JAX JIT compilation
get_input_size: get the input size property of an OddsFirst task which returns the vocab_size
get_output_size: get the output size property of an OddsFirst task which returns the vocab_size
compute_output_length: compute the output length for a given input length in an OddsFirst task which returns the same length
